references.name: claude-code

references.name: codex
references.auth: subscription: the ChatGPT login's auth.json named by CODEX_AUTH_JSON_PATH in harbor's environment (CU_GATE_CODEX_AUTH, else ~/.config/vulcanbench/codex-gate/auth.json, else ~/.codex/auth.json), as scripts/frontier-v5/run_gate.sh
references.tools: mcp__computer__* only, called from Codex code mode's exec
references.config: scripts/computer-use/codex-gate.toml plus a one-model catalog built per gate invocation by scripts/computer-use/codex_catalog.py (apply_patch and subagent tools cleared)
references.note: Same subscription reference, config and locked catalog as the Linux suite; the MCP computer tools run with --backend vnc against the trial's macOS VM.
